h: 探索带有集成 LORA Loader 的简单 SDXL 工作流程，用于创建高质量图像。该工作流程不仅易于使用，而且易于扩展。深入图像编辑的世界，体验工作流程优化的轻松！

o.en: Discover the simple SDXL workflow with integrated LORA Loader for creating high-quality images. Not only is this workflow easy to use, but it's also easy to expand. Dive into the world of image editing and experience the ease of workflow optimization!
